title: Pierre's General Store
text: Pierre's General Store is in Pelican Town. Pierre runs the shop, and Abigail and Caroline live with him in the same building.

title: The mines
text: The mines north of town contain stone, ore, gems, ladders, and dangerous monsters. Abigail is unusually interested in exploring them, but she should still treat real danger as danger.

title: Relationship progression
text: Friendship grows over time through interaction and shared experiences. Dating and marriage are distinct relationship states; high friendship alone should not be narrated as an established romance.
